summary: P0 Desktop Responsive / Scrollability verification for Quote Editor + multi-category configurator. Verified sticky DialogHeader/DialogFooter and max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] + overflow-y-auto pattern in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/dialog.jsx across 4 desktop viewports (1280x720, 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080), 125% zoom (1093x614 emulated), and mobile 390x844. Ran principale, modify, warning-visible, cassonetti, customer-portal-mobile and mobile-configurator flows. All pass; sticky footer confirm/cancel is always inside the viewport and the dialog content scrolls internally without horizontal document overflow.

test_results_detail.test_principale_1366x768: PASS — opening PROEVOLUTION, waiting for price, clicking multi-cat-confirm adds a new line (5→6, toast 'Riga aggiunta' shown, dialog closes). NB: transient disabled state (~400ms debounce + backend mutation) is normal; button becomes enabled and click succeeds.
test_results_detail.test_warning_1280x720_needs_po_pricing: PASS — multi-cat-preview panel with NEEDS_PO_PRICING is inside viewport, multi-cat-confirm remains disabled AND visible in sticky footer.
test_results_detail.test_zoom_125pct_1366x768: PASS — with document.body.style.zoom='1.25' and viewport 1366x768, multi-cat-confirm bbox y=667/bottom=703 vs vh=768 (visible).
test_results_detail.test_cassonetti_1280x720: PASS — dialog scrollable, footer confirm visible.
test_results_detail.mobile_configurator_390x844: PASS — scrollH=1328, clientH=810 (scrollable), multi-cat-confirm visible at y=707/bottom=743 vs vh=844 (sticky footer).

critical_code_review_comments: dialog.jsx: sticky header/footer implemented cleanly via -mx-6 -mt-6 / -mb-6 negative margins to bleed through the scrollable content padding and cover scrollbar rail — good pattern.
DialogContent uses `overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain` and `max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)]` which correctly caps height on all desktop resolutions and 125% zoom.

MultiCategoryConfiguratorDialog: right column (visual+prezzo) has `lg:sticky lg:top-16 self-start` so warnings/prezzo remain in view while left column scrolls; scrollIntoView on validation errors also implemented (line 134). Good.
Consider: on very small heights (<=600px, e.g. laptops at 150% zoom) the sticky header + sticky footer eat vertical space; scrollable middle can become <150px. Not blocking but worth noting.
Radix Select options inside portal work but tests need ~300-400ms after opening trigger; keep note in E2E docs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 flows across 4 desktop + zoom + mobile viewports)
